scoring_summary.structural_finding: Pre-validated filing is the Supernova SPAC's last pre-merger 10-K (CIK 0001838359, filed 2022-02-23, FY ended 2021-12-31). It contains no Rigetti operating disclosure, no DoD program names, no PE numbers, no AFRL/DARPA contract narrative. The J-Book Exposure Divergence pattern cannot be tested against this artifact. All five extracted claims are SPAC-shell or control claims; pentagon_jbook fired only on the adjacent IonQ analog (CONTROL, not a Rigetti claim). The framework's correct PIT-2023-01-15 verdict for this filing is UNVERIFIABLE w.r.t. the cohort thesis. Operator note: refresh_cohort_filings.py picked a pre-merger SPAC 10-K; the first Rigetti operating 10-K under this CIK is 0001193125-23-080486_10-K (filed 2023-03-27) — outside the PIT 2023-01-15 cutoff. So as of 2023-01-15 NO Rigetti annual report existed; only the 10-Qs (0001193125-22-218918, 0001193125-22-290115) and the S-1 (0001193125-22-218934). This is itself a meaningful framework finding: under strict PIT 2023-01-15, RGTI has no 10-K to extract J-Book claims from.
